title: Addins configuration for rstudio-server and apache?
description:
I'm trying to use the new addins with RStudio Server (on my own dedicated host proxied through apache). Problem is they try to spawn local browser windows at http://127.0.0.1 and that fails as I'm not running RStudio locally. 
Do I need to add rules to my apache vhost configuration to make this work?
Thanks.

```
> rhandsontable:::editAddin()
Loading required package: shiny
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3883
> addinslist:::addinslistAddin()
Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3883
```

title: Requires Rtools v.3.1?
description:
I tried installing the addins examples, using your command: 
`devtools::install_github("rstudio/addinexamples", type = "source")`

... and got the error message:
`WARNING: Rtools 3.3 found on the path at C:/RBUILD~1/3.3 is not compatible with R 3.2.2.`

`Please download and install Rtools 3.1 from http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/, remove the incompatible version from your PATH, then run find_rtools().`

Is it normal that you should require v.3.1?
